description: Turn parallel sentences (language A + language B) into one alternating practice track. Each sentence is spoken by the same neural voices used on bilingualmix.com, then stitched A1→B1→A2→B2 with configurable gaps. Returns a 6-hour download URL (WAV) plus a per-sentence timeline in seconds. Use dry_run=true first to preview the pair list and the cost without spending quota. Free tier: 2 runs / 20 min per day (anonymous, per IP), up to 8 pairs. Signing in doubles it; members get 500 min/month.

dry_run.description: Preview pairs and estimated cost only. Free, no quota used.

gap_ms.description: Silence between a and b of the same pair, milliseconds.

pairs.description: Sentence pairs. a = first language, b = second language. Leave one side empty to auto-translate (members only).

text.description: Alternative to pairs: one sentence per line for language A.

text_b.description: Optional second column, one sentence per line, same line count as text.

name: create_bilingual_audio
title: Create bilingual interleaved audio
